sites.source: FS page ('This campground has 14 sites') and site map (one loop, 1-14, host 11; squares = vehicle sites 1, 4-14, circles 2-3); recreation.gov catalog: STANDARD NONELECTRIC RV/Trailer 40 ft sites 7, 12, 13; 35 ft 14; 30 ft 4, 5, 6, 10 - all 8 catalogued sites take 23 ft+; sites 1, 8, 9 not catalogued (first-come, length unknown); typed driveways Back-In gravel

facilities.source: FS page ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site'); recreation.gov ('Accessible restrooms and a hand pump for water are provided ... There are no showers or a dump station')

values.note: Mid-May to mid-October; recreation.gov sells 2027 nights May 20 to October 11.

season.source: FS page (Seasons of Use 'Mid-May to Mid-October'); recreation.gov rates ('Peak Season 2027-05-20 to 2027-10-11')

discounts.source: FS page ('Senior and Access pass holders receive a 50% discount')

note: On NH-113 at the south end of Evans Notch, about 15 miles north of Fryeburg, ME, on one wooded loop with a picnic pavilion; the road to Basin Pond leaves just north. Two pets per site. --Claude
summary: FS page + site map + rec.gov 232175: 14 sites on one loop, 8 reservable RV spurs 30-40 ft (all fit 23 ft), the rest first-come; $24 on recreation.gov (FS page says $30) + $6 extra vehicle; vault toilets and hand-pump water, no showers or dump; mid-May to mid-October; 2/3-night weekend/holiday minimums. Not waterfront (the river is not beside the loop).
flags: FEE CONFLICT: recreation.gov rates $24 (2026-2028 seasons); the FS page (updated April 24, 2026) says 'Single Site: $30 per night'. Kept $24 per the trust-recreation.gov rule.

PHONE: 877-444-6777 (recreation.gov call centre) -> 802-289-0970 (recreation.gov: 'For facility specific information, please call (802) 289-0970', the concessionaire). recreation.gov's facility phone field shows 603-447-2166.

Waterfront: not waterfront confirmed. The loop lies west of NH-113 under continuous canopy; the FS map shows no river beside it ('Just a short distance from the Cold River and beautiful Basin Pond'), and no site sits near water on Esri.
Pin 44.26447,-71.01333 (= FS lat/long) sits ~80 m south-west of site 10, beside the loop - fine.
